svg.title: What CI does: the gate, the night, and what travels between them
svg.desc: Two lanes and one box underneath them. The left lane is the gate, which every push and every pull request runs and which never touches the network: ruff over src, tests, showcase and scripts; then the checks that need no site — pure logic, parsing of pages saved from the real sites, and the pipeline against a real SQLite file; then the browser check, 12 cases driving Chromium against the demo store this repository starts itself. Both jobs upload their Allure results. The right lane is the night, started by the schedule (cron 0 5 * * *) or by a manual run with the publish box ticked, and only once the gate is green: probe both practice sites and record what each answered; restore the database from the last publication; scrape every source that answered, export the snapshots and record the scroll of the demo store; run the live checks, 3 cases against the real sites, where a red one is the drift signal and is not allowed to stop the night; then, on the main branch only, merge every job's results, generate the Allure report with the history carried over, build the page and force-push the whole site to gh-pages. The box underneath is the database itself, carried from one night to the next through gh-pages: it holds 30 nights per source, which is what gives a nightly diff a yesterday to compare with, and the restore step pulls it back down before the next scrape.
svg.text: What CI does with every change, and what it does at night
The gate never touches the network. The night is the only run that reaches the practice sites — and the only one that publishes.
ruff check
src · tests · showcase · scripts
one rule set over everything, tests included
the checks that need no site
pytest -m "unit or parsers or integration"
pure logic · pages saved from the real sites ·
the pipeline against a real SQLite file
nothing here asks anyone for anything
the browser check
pytest -m e2e
12 cases
Chromium against the demo store, which this
repository starts itself — still no live site
both jobs upload their allure-results
so the night can report on the whole suite, not its own leg
what starts it
cron 0 5 * * *
or a manual run with the publish box ticked
and, either way, only once the gate is green
probe the practice sites
curl asks each one for a status code
what does not answer is skipped for the night,
with what it did answer recorded as the reason
restore the database
scripts/restore-db.sh
without it every night is a first night and
every record is reported as added
scrape what answered, and keep it
scrapewatch scrape all --export-dir
the snapshots are exported as CSV and JSON
record-scroll leaves the video of the demo
store's infinite scroll, and the trace of it
the live checks
pytest -m live
3 cases
a red one is drift, and never stops the night
publish, on the main branch only
merge every job's results · Allure with the history
carried over · showcase/build.py builds the page
the whole site is force-pushed to gh-pages
the database, carried from one night to the next
30 nights per source
published with the data, pulled back down before the next scrape — the only reason a nightly diff has a yesterday
THE GATE — EVERY PUSH AND EVERY PULL REQUEST
THE NIGHT — AND THE ONLY RUN THAT PUBLISHES
